description.value: Historic Downtown Abbotsford is a walkable heritage neighbourhood established in 1891, sitting on the unceded territory of the Semá:th and Mathxwí First Nations and home to over 225 businesses including boutique retailers, award-winning restaurants, galleries, and murals. The Abbotsford Downtown Business Association manages a dedicated outdoor events space called Open Space and hosts seasonal festivals such as Berry Fest and Winter Jubilee. Touring cyclists will find a dense cluster of dining and shopping options within a compact, strollable footprint in the Fraser Valley.
